basic_info.description: Elevate your lifestyle at 25 Sierra St #E302  a sundrenched,top-floor sanctuary on Potrero Hill. This bright + voluminous 3Bed/2Bath home features a modern open floor plan with jaw-dropping ceiling height in the living/dining/kitchen areas. Natural light pours through oversized windows in the living space, framing glimpses of the Bay. Unwind in 2 private outdoor spaces that flow seamlessly from the main living areaideal for morning coffee, golden evenings with friends, or relaxing with a book. The main level includes a guest bedroom + full bath, while 2 additional bedrooms and a 2nd bath are located upstairs. Enjoy in-unit laundry, elevator access, and 2-car parking (1 right next to the elevator). Community amenities include a landscaped courtyard w/BBQ, a secure entry + mail room. Located at the crossroads of Potrero Hill + Dogpatch, urban amenities are moments away: dining hotspots + artisan shops, UCSF, Crane Cove Park, the Chase Center, easy freeway and Caltrain access for adventures farther afield. With the proposed redevelopment of Pier 70 set to bring new parks, dining, arts spaces, and waterfront access, the area is poised for an exciting new chapter. Live amidst the best of San Francisco  at 25 Sierra St #E302, a vibrant world awaits just outside your door!
